title: The Zombies Run From Me
summary: An immune ten-year-old turns zombies human with a high five. He saves his mom with a hug and discovers why Gary still looks tired.
frame_0: A smiling boy in a red hoodie offers a high five. Green commuters with backpacks sprint away down Clement Avenue. One looks back at him beside the BEWARE OF KID sign.
package_differences: Claude requested golden-hour streets, deep teal shadows, a cheerful lead, and neon dusk for this look revision.
Steady cuts open the story. From 25 seconds the camera glides between the truck, school, barricade, river and Gary.
A short tune comes from the ice cream truck. Street and prop sounds accompany the original narration.
A postal cart hoists the boy’s box over the car wall. The box lands, walks on his feet and folds open.
Gary receives the tenth high five on the final hold. The sponsor edition extends the scene into the approved 9.3-second phone ending.
camera_treatment: Steady opening cuts, then one smooth moving shot from frame 750.
